Yong Hee Lee

TLDR
Cuckoo is a real-time AI translator for global sales, marketing, and support. Companies like Snowflake and PagerDuty use Cuckoo in Zoom and in-person meetings for even the most technical discussions.
Here an example of us having a product, sales, and partner meeting with our W25 batchmates and one of our partners in Japan: https://youtu.be/7fq7wr_S8p0
—
Hey everyone! We are Yong Hee and Gunwoo and we are building Cuckoo to help global teams talk to their customers worldwide. Give it a try in your next global meeting 🌏
Why?
Language barriers are a big challenge even for global companies. We experienced this firsthand in Korea, where we hosted community meetups, inviting product leaders around the world.
On the one hand, many nuances and details can get lost between languages, especially during technical conversations.
Cuckoo provides real-time translation tailored for you and your customers. It instantly learns technical details from your documents—pitch decks, meeting notes, API docs—and delivers context-aware translation in 20+ languages.
How it works
A bit about us
Gunwoo and Yong Hee first met in 2015 through a student club at KAIST, where we organized an annual international conference for undergraduate students. Since then, we have been talking about starting a company together.

About
Based in California, US, and founded in 2024 by co-founders Gunwoo Kim (CEO) and Yong Hee Lee (COO), Cuckoo Labs Inc.
operates as a provider of AI-powered real-time interpretation services to global teams and organizations, helping them communicate effectively across multiple languages in professional settings. In January 2025, Cuckoo Labs Inc. raised an undisclosed amount of venture funding from Y Combinator.
Cuckoo offers an AI interpretation service intended to facilitate communication in multilingual environments. Its core product functions as a real-time interpreter that learns from ongoing conversations, enabling users to convey complex details across more than ten languages.
The service integrates with communication platforms such as Zoom, Google Meet, Slack, and Teams, making it accessible for both mobile and desktop users. The product serves global teams and organizations planning events, meetings, and webinars, enabling seamless discussions without language barriers.
The solution is aimed primarily at international markets, especially North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Cuckoo Labs generates revenue through subscription-based packages. The Professional Plan is priced at USD 100 per user per month, offering unlimited interpretation, platform integration, and priority support.
